The script [`/app/filter.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9epr5iwn/filter.py) has been created to remove JavaScript from HTML files and protect against XSS attacks.

### Implementation Details
- Uses `BeautifulSoup` with `html.parser` to parse and maintain the standard HTML structure and formatting.
- Decomposes executable tags such as `<script>`, `<frame>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, and `<embed>`.
- Identifies and strips inline event listener attributes (attributes starting with `on`, such as `onload`, `onerror`, `onclick`, `onfocus`, etc.).
- Strips `javascript:` URI schemes and escapes any remaining `<script` instances.
- Takes the target HTML file path as `sys.argv[1]` and updates the file in-place.
- Preserves clean HTML formatting and structure.
